title: The Empty Shoes
text: A street lined with shoes, a pair set neatly by every door, as if their owners stepped out of them and kept walking. Bare footprints lead away down the cobbles, hundreds of them, all going the same way. Not one comes back.

outcomes.text: To a square where the faceless dance, barefoot and silent, and they let you watch.

options.label: The shrewdest searches the empty houses.

outcomes.text: Every house left as if for a moment, the kettle still warm, and coins on the table.

options.label: Keep your own shoes on, and keep moving.

outcomes.text: Your feet ache to be bare all day.
